authenticity_review: The image displays significant structural artifacts that undermine mechanical plausibility. The wheel assemblies on the middle-row left truck (yellow dump trailer) exhibit severe geometric collapse—tires appear fused and lack distinct rims/axles. Similarly, the top-row right truck shows smudged undercarriage details near rear wheels. The bottom-right yellow truck has disproportionately small rear wheels relative to its chassis, indicating perspective/scaling errors. While the illustrative/vector art style provides some leniency for texture simplification, these are fundamental structural failures in load-bearing components, not stylistic choices. The perceptual_quality_auditor correctly noted no graphics-level distortion (noise/compression), but this misses the critical structural defects that fall outside its specialty.

Structural collapse in wheel assemblies (middle-left and top-right trucks)
Proportional distortion in bottom-right truck rear wheels
Taxonomic mismatch: Generated heavy-duty commercial trucks instead of light-duty pickups
